title: Wines Suite
program_note:
This Wines Suite was written between July, 1985 and December, 1987.  The bulk of musical material was conceived between July and September, 1985.  Only two movements, however, Port and Sauternes, reached any stage of completion before November, 1985.  The rest of the movements were written, and the Suite as a whole was completed, between August and December, 1987.

The movements of the Suite have many different characters.  Only two movements, Champagne at the beginning and Sauternes at the end, feature what could be considered true tonal harmonic progressions, but they are all united in their tonal implications, and in the importance of the interval of a fourth.  All movements stress a tonic and a dominant.

The programmatic titles are meant more as suggestions as to the character of the movements than as hard and fast relationships between the music and the different varieties of wine.  The titles are meant to add meaning to the listener or the performer; the movements are not meant to portray each wine.

The total duration is approximately 23 minutes.  The performer should feel free to add pedaling to his or her own tastes.

David S. Lefkowitz

3 December, 1987

Philadelphia, PA.
